data.subject: See YEW on the dance floor: YEWsletter Bonus 10/21/26
data.preheader: Get your tickets for Friday's Dance Nite fundraiser and check out other upcoming events
data.intro:
We're prepping for [Dance Nite at the  Hopewell Train Station](https://ecopto.org/events/2026-09-21-dance-nite/) this Friday from 7 to 10pm - [get your tickets](https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/autumn-dance-party) and join us for this fundraiser as we raise money to support projects and initiatives this school year, including outdoor learning opportunities!  (And if you haven't had the chance to play around with the full interactive flyer with real working puzzle, record player, and train... [click (and scroll) here!)](https://ecopto.org/dance/)

And read on for upcoming events, details on our [October meeting on 10/28](https://ecopto.org/events/2026-08-26-ecopto-meeting/), and ways to help as we bring our district together to work for social and ecological justice and Youth and Earth Wellbeing (Y.E.W.).
data.closing:
With gratitude for all of YEW, 

Karen Le Morvan

ecoPTO communications
